conclusion: The default headless Chrome transport received HTTP 403 through Hostinger hcdn. Disabling HTTP/2 and QUIC allowed a real production HTTP/1.1 Lighthouse audit. No host security settings were changed. This isolates a transport/client-dependent response, not the exact CDN rule responsible.
